name: libxsmm-scratch-lifetime-blocked
hypothesis: The selected experiment conflicts with its preservation requirements. Both existing K loops advance scratch by 256 bytes per K step and rewind 131072 bytes. The first 32-row tile alone accesses through scratch byte 130943, so reducing allocation to 65536 bytes without changing consumption would exceed bounds. The current traversal computes both 32-row halves for each B panel before advancing that panel. Computing all B panels for the first half before repacking the second half changes that traversal. A working 64 KiB design therefore requires changes to scratch stride, rewinds, second-half addressing, and compute traversal outside the permitted allocation/packing block. I cannot implement all stated requirements together or substitute a different experiment. No source changes or tests were performed.
